A '''pressure regulator''', also known as a '''pressurizer''', was a component used to control the pressure in [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Pressure suit/Legends|pressure suits]] as well as in the buildings that housed members of non-Skakoan [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skako/Legends|Skako]].<ref name="PH:S">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/PHSkako|series=Planet Hoppers|text=Skako}}</ref>
